metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow got a triple kill? Valorant’s bug or gift?!
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
Valorant just handed me 3 kills like free candy
Click if your aim’s a beautiful accident too!

Tap if your best plays come from pure panic too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
